ablations.no_history: frequency only; chronological history unavailable to screening or expensive models
ablations.no_memory: selector utility history reset at decisions; native predictive history retained, not MNEMONIC ablation
ablations.no_selection: fixed native choice with controller bookkeeping; no adaptive strategy selection
ablations.no_structure: screen disabled; bounded exploration continues without structural ordering

budgets.hard_cpu_limit_note: CPU measured; equal wall and Job memory/process ceilings, no independent CPU-time kill limit

design.cost_calibration: fixed development initialization wall and full-loop wall per observation; realized whole-process CPU is evaluated separately
design.failure_rule: retain every attempted trial and cost; any missing/failed arm prevents complete paired efficacy assessment

generator.actions: one RNG.random per step; probability1 .08 for sparse_noisy, .5 otherwise
generator.delayed: a XOR action at lag3, flip .075
generator.outcome_draw: one RNG.random drawn only AFTER this arm forecasts
generator.unseen_structure: a XOR (outcome at lag2 AND action at lag5), flip .075

design.information: predictor receives current binary action and previously observed binary outcomes only; never family/seed/future
limits: trusted generated binary streams only; no coding/transfer/energy/GPU claim
unseen structure excludes development outcomes, but its generator is designed and known
reported native Job peak is a high-water counter, potentially including attempted charges; strict committed peak remains HOLD
cost estimates and uncertainty proxies do not establish optimal allocation or causal benefit

bootstrap.purpose: descriptive paired seed-block mean interval, not extra independent evidence

metrics.ece: 10 fixed equal-width bins, left-closed/right-open except final includes1; weighted absolute calibration error
metrics.meaning: directional seed-block evidence; shifted-margin sign criterion is not mean-equivalence proof
metrics.multiplicity: Holm correction across nine one-sided paired exact sign tests, alpha .05; ties <=1e-12 omitted
metrics.unit: eight independent seed blocks; average eight family streams within each seed

schedule.order: seed-family groups, shuffled with independent registered schedule seed; modes shuffled within every group
